decisions.reason: It remained important enough for its own page through 2019, and for a medium-sized, established machinery firm with some organizational slack this suggests performance likely stayed near aspiration even if later evidence is missing.

An automatic airless spray gun fits closely with the firm’s core application equipment business, making it more likely to meet comparative aspirations and be retained.
